200.title: President Zardari Greets Polish President Karol Nawrocki on Poland’s Independence Day
200.summary: Pakistan President Zardari Greets Polish President Karol Nawrocki on Poland’s Independence Day Published November 10, 2026 | 5:25 PM 1 min read President Asif Ali Zardari conveyed greetings on behalf of Pakistan’s government and people, expressing confidence that longstanding bilateral ties with Poland will deepen through expanded cooperation.
200.body: Pakistan President Zardari Greets Polish President Karol Nawrocki on Poland’s Independence Day Published November 10, 2026 | 5:25 PM 1 min read President Asif Ali Zardari conveyed greetings on behalf of Pakistan’s government and people, expressing confidence that longstanding bilateral ties with Poland will deepen through expanded cooperation. ISLAMABAD, (Pakistan Point News - 10th Nov, 2026) President Asif Ali Zardari extended warm felicitations and best wishes to President of the Republic of Poland, Karol Nawrocki, and the people of Poland on the occasion of their National Independence Day. “In a letter addressed to President Karol Nawrocki, President Zardari conveyed greetings on behalf of the Government and people of Pakistan, and in his personal capacity,” the President Secretariat Media Wing said in a press release. 600.title: Senegal and Poland strike gold at Youth Olympic Games Dakar 2026
600.summary: DAKAR (Senegal) – Senegal's men and Poland's women emerged as the 3x3 basketball champions at the Youth Olympic Games Dakar 2026, bringing four days of competition to a thrilling conclusion on November 9. Poland and Senegal emerged as champions after two dramatic gold medal games, while Senegal's men's triumph gave the home supporters an additional reason to celebrate.
600.body: DAKAR (Senegal) – Senegal's men and Poland's women emerged as the 3x3 basketball champions at the Youth Olympic Games Dakar 2026, bringing four days of competition to a thrilling conclusion on November 9. Poland edged China 12-11 in the women's gold medal game, while Senegal delighted the home crowd with a dramatic 14-13 victory over Lithuania to secure the men's title. Men's Tournament Senegal men delivered a memorable performance in front of their home supporters, winning all five of their games to capture the men's 3x3 basketball gold medal at Dakar 2026. Poland and Senegal emerged as champions after two dramatic gold medal games, while Senegal's men's triumph gave the home supporters an additional reason to celebrate.
